title: ActionPayload
description: Represents an action that can either be an "upsert" or "delete."

DeleteActionPayload.description: Payload for deleting an existing transaction by ID.

value.description: The monetary value of the transaction.

category.description: The category of the transaction, either 'payable' or 'receivable.'

TransactionId.description: The unique ID referencing a single transaction (or booking).

UpsertActionPayload.description: Payload for an "upsert" action, meaning update the record if it exists, or insert it if it does not.

account_number.description: The account number from the request's "accounts" section.

period_end_date.description: The end date for the period of the transaction.

transaction_id.description: The unique ID referencing multiple transactions (or bookings) as a group.

journal_id.description: A unique identifier from the source system for the journal used to record this transaction. Transactions sharing the same journal_id will be grouped and accessible via a link in the Silverfin UI.

journal_type.description: The type of journal from the source system (e.g. "Sales", "Purchases", "Bank", "General").

booking_date.description: The date when the transaction was booked.

description.description: A detailed description of the transaction.

relation.description: The relation of the transaction, required if 'open_transaction' is provided.

document_id.description: The ID of the associated document.

analytical_dimensions.description: Array of analytical dimension labels, with a maximum of 6 items.

extra_fields.description: Additional fields related to the transaction. Must have the same size as 'extra_field_labels' if provided.
